faq.q: How did Coquitlam sell in September 2026?
faq.a: City-wide: 425 detached listings with 44 sold at a $1,455,000 median, and 806 Condos & Townhomes listings with 89 sold at a $625,000 median — both medians the lowest of the September 2025 – September 2026 period; the highest published sub-area ratios were Meadow Brook detached at 50% (2 sales on 4 listings) and Ranch Park attached at 100% (1 sale on 1 listing), both small-count figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How many homes can a Coquitlam single-family lot hold?
faq.a: Up to four dwelling units in low-density neighbourhoods under the City's small-scale residential zones — 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m² and 4 units on lots 280 m² or larger in the R-1/R-2 zones, in forms including suites, laneway homes, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes, subject to property-specific eligibility.

Eagle Ridge Hospital at 475 Guildford Way in Port Moody, on the Port Moody/Coquitlam border, with a 24-hour emergency department and acute, ambulatory and long-term care programs; the region's major tertiary hospital is Royal Columbian in New Westminster.

faq.q: When are property taxes due in Coquitlam?
faq.a: For 2026, City of Coquitlam property taxes were due July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to unpaid current taxes after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% after September 15, 2026, including unclaimed Home Owner Grants.
